added.description: Scheduled by documents dated inside the run.

closing.description: What they hold at the end: opening + added - released + reversed, exactly.

opening.description: What its schedules held on the day before the run.

party_id.description: The customer or supplier; left out for a spread with none, such as a bank line.

party_name.description: Their name, or 'No customer or supplier' for a spread with none.

released.description: Released to the profit and loss inside the run.

reversed.description: Reversed or cancelled inside the run: a reversed release, a credit note, an edit or a cancellation; it moves the balance either way.
